description:
[read-only] One post's video watch data per platform: average watch time, % watched, completion, retention curve, holds, quartiles, video length and its source. A metric the platform did not report is listed in `notReported` with the reason, never 0. A post outside this connection's brand answers 404. Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics/posts/{id}/watch.)
name: get_post_watch
title: Post watch and retention
